description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] and [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Awoken Dawn of Fantasy] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Awoken Dawn of Fantasy
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Holy abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time
